title: console: publish-all seed warning toast prints the seed loader's engine text and an English 'NAME: sample data failed to load' instead of the pack sentence
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbYRqkDAGuse5Wqbohi

Filing gate ① (product defect, named producer). Out-of-scope finding from the os-dev report on #34553 (PR #35139), sibling of that card's `issues[].message` fix. Dedupe: `is:issue usePublishAllDrafts seedError` → 2 hits (#34553 open, #32984 closed; neither covers the seed detail); `is:issue seedError` → same 2; `is:issue "publish all" seed toast` → 60 hits, none on this toast's description.

## Defect

`ui/packages/app-shell/src/preview/usePublishAllDrafts.ts` (Home's *Publish all* and the draft-preview bar) shows the `home.pendingDrafts.seedWarn` warning with `description: seedProblems[0]`, and `seedProblems` is filled from two places that are not user sentences:

- `recordHealth` pushes `health.seedError` first, which is the seed loader's engine text (for example "seed apply stopped at the seed for object X"), and uses the pack sentence `chatbot.build.health.seedFailed` only when the producer sent none.
- The package-less loop pushes `seedApplied.error ?? \`${d.name}: sample data failed to load\``: engine text again, else a hard-coded English sentence in every locale.

For the same publish answer, the chat's `PublishHealthLine` (`ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/ChatbotEnhanced.tsx`, objectstack#32984) never voices `seedError`: it says the pack sentence and folds the engine text under "Technical details". The toast should follow the same rule: the pack sentence `chatbot.build.health.seedFailed` (or a producer customer sentence if one is ever added), never the engine text, never literal English.

reach: named real producer (the two call sites above, read from code on origin/main 958ee035). A live reading (a seed that fails on Publish all, in `zh-Hans`) is the first step of the fix.

## Why it matters

A builder who publishes from Home in Chinese sees English loader internals under the warning, which the #32984 Q1 ruling says user-facing text must not show (`userMessage`, never the developer's text). The chat already follows it; this door does not.

## Reader

Console UI lane (`domain:ui`), the area holding `ui/packages/app-shell/src/preview/`; on repo:objectstack#1 that is area o1-B. Fix after PR #35139 lands (same file).

Grading: p2 · who: any builder whose seed fails on Publish all / the draft bar · door: the seedWarn toast · frequency: every failed seed · read from code. User-visible wrong-language text with the warning title still correct (北极星 p2: user-visible defect, not data loss).
